conditions.baseline: Original used body-goal joint law and original K action
conditions.oracle_goal_center: Replace root marker modal translation/rotation by physical truth; retain all original covariance/cross numbers in the new local chart
conditions.oracle_body_centers: Replace six body local modal centers by actual local transforms at exact source physical frame; retain all original covariance/cross numbers in new local charts
conditions.goal_width_01: Multiply goal standard coordinates by0.1 or0.01 via Pnew=D P D^T, including all cross; centers retained
conditions.body_width_01: Multiply six body standard coordinates by0.1 or0.01 via Pnew=D P D^T, including all cross; centers retained
conditions.true_K: Use simulator true K for the anchored auxiliary equilibrium action only; retain original body and goal law

physical_direction_scope: FK Jacobian at recorded actual theta times true-K quasistatic equilibrium command Jacobian; dynamic lag/velocity are not simulated. This is a common frozen diagnostic transfer for all conditions, not actual next-tick motion or closed-loop result.
mean_oracle_scope: A counterfactual recentering with identical local-coordinate covariance/cross; not an exact Bayesian conditioning or push-forward of the original distribution.
